subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the italicized part.

Ravi has always been *a person who vehemently opposes authority, control, or tradition*, often challenging every rule set before him.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Anarchist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Anarchist"** refers to a person who opposes all forms of authority, control, or traditional societal norms and advocates for the absence of government or hierarchical systems. (अराजकतावादी)
 
 
• **Example:** The anarchist refused to follow the rules set by the government and advocated for self-governance.
 
 
• In the given sentence, Ravi is described as someone who vehemently opposes authority, control, or tradition. This aligns with the definition of an anarchist.
